run_deduplicate_lines: run the script to deduplicate lines in one or more text files using MD5 hashing
run_deduplicate_lines_with_workers: run the deduplication script with a custom number of worker processes for parallel hashing
run_deduplicate_lines_stdin: run the script with no file arguments to deduplicate lines from standard input
review_get_hashes_and_lines: review the get_hashes_and_lines function that computes an MD5 hash for a raw line of text
refactor_main_deduplication: refactor the main deduplication loop to use a different hashing algorithm instead of MD5
